forceTimeoutSettlement((address[],uint25.details: Same finalStacks-direct accounting as {settleHand}, but the verifier      is skipped (§11.11) and any declared winner without a valid signature      forfeits their entire share to the operator (§11.10). `lastRoundState`      must be signed by all players (§11.9) and is bound by handId.

params.lastRoundState: Latest signed betting-round state (proof of pot at cutoff).
params.outcome: Proposed outcome; may have partial winner signatures.

params.init: The original hand initialization (handId recomputed from it).
params.winnerSignatures: EIP-712 signatures from every address in `outcome.winners`.

assertHandMembership((address[],uint256[.notice: Activates a hand: verifies all players signed `init`, recomputes         the handId, and locks each player's buy-in.

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposits `amount` of the token into the caller's vault balance.

lockedOf(address).notice: Amount of `player`'s balance currently locked across active hands.

oracle().notice: The configuration oracle resolved for rake + operator at settlement.

settleHand((address[],uint256[],address,.notice: Settles an active hand to vault balances, taking oracle rake.

token().notice: The ERC20 token this settler escrows.
